29/* @brief Basic operational-space PD controller parameters.
30 *
31 * Minimal parameter set for a robot-agnostic task-space impedance controller.
32 * See ControllerBasicOscPd for details. */
33struct ControllerBasicOscPdParams {
34 /* Tracking gains */
35 real Kp_p = 0_r; /* Position gain [N/m] */
36 real Kd_p = 0_r; /* Position damping gain [Ns/m] */
37 real Kp_r = 0_r; /* Rotation gain [Nm/rad] */
38 real Kd_r = 0_r; /* Rotation damping gain [Nms/rad] */
39
40 /* If true, renormalize the task-space error so translation and rotation errors stay below their
41 * configured maximums, keeping the force direction consistent. Requires positive
42 * maxTranslationError and maxRotationError. */
43 bool bApplyMaxErrorMagnitudeNormalization = true;
44
45 /* Max translation error for normalization in control space [m]. Must be positive when enabled. */
46 real maxTranslationError = 0_r;
47 /* Max rotation error for normalization in control space [rad]. Must be positive when enabled. */
48 real maxRotationError = 0_r;
49
50 /* The transform of the actual end-effector in the end-effector link space */
51 TransformRT EELinkFromEE = TransformRT::Identity();
52
53 /* If true, scale the output efforts down uniformly so that no controlled DOF exceeds the
54 * per-joint effort limit harvested from the controller's BotPrefab (see Initialize), preserving
55 * the task-space force direction. Requires the controller to have been constructed with a
56 * BotPrefab; only joints with a finite (positive) effortLimit constrain the scaling — unbounded
57 * (negative) and non-actuated (zero) joints are ignored. */
58 bool bApplyMaxOSCTorqueNormalization = true;
59
60 /**
61 * @brief Load controller parameters from a JSON file.
62 * @param[in] path Path to a .superdex_controller JSON file.
63 * @param[in,out] error Error status.
64 * @return Loaded parameters, or default-constructed on failure.
65 */
66 static MOCHI_API ControllerBasicOscPdParams
67 LoadFromFile(std::string_view path, superdex::Error& error);
68
69 /**
70 * @brief Save controller parameters to a JSON file.
71 * @param[in] path Destination file path.
72 * @param[in,out] error Error status.
73 */
74 MOCHI_API void SaveToFile(std::string_view path, superdex::Error& error) const;
75
76 MOCHI_STRUCT_BEGIN(superdex::robotics::ControllerBasicOscPdParams)
77 MOCHI_FIELD(Kp_p) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("N/m"));
78 MOCHI_FIELD(Kd_p) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("Ns/m"));
79 MOCHI_FIELD(Kp_r) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("Nm/rad"));
80 MOCHI_FIELD(Kd_r) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("Nms/rad"));
81 MOCHI_FIELD(bApplyMaxErrorMagnitudeNormalization);
82 MOCHI_FIELD(maxTranslationError) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("m"));
83 MOCHI_FIELD(maxRotationError) MOCHI_ATTRIBUTE(Units("rad"));
84 MOCHI_FIELD(EELinkFromEE);
85 MOCHI_FIELD(bApplyMaxOSCTorqueNormalization);
86 MOCHI_STRUCT_END()
87};

89/* @brief Observation state — robot state variables read each control step.
90 * Fill it with GetCurrentObservationsFromMochi to read the live simulation, or populate it
91 * directly from an external state source (e.g., a real robot). */
92struct ControllerBasicOscPdObsv {
93 DynamicArray<real> dofPositions; /* All DOF positions [rad or m] */
94 DynamicArray<real> dofVelocities; /* All DOF velocities [rad/s or m/s] */
95 TransformRT worldFromRoot = TransformRT::Identity(); /* Root link pose in world frame */
96 TransformRT worldFromEELink = TransformRT::Identity(); /* EE link pose in world frame */
97 DynamicArray<real> eeJacobian; /* 6×numDofs EE Jacobian in world frame (row-major) */
98};
99
100/* @brief Target setpoint for the controller. */
101struct ControllerBasicOscPdTarget {
102 TransformRT rootFromTargetEE = TransformRT::Identity(); /* Target EE pose in root frame */
103};

118/* @brief Basic operational-space PD (impedance) controller for robotic arms.
119 *
120 * Computes joint torques via the Jacobian transpose method: tau = J^T * F, where
121 * F = Kp * pose_error + Kd * velocity_error combines position/rotation tracking errors with PD
122 * gains. This is the minimal, robot-agnostic core of operational-space control:
123 *
124 * - No nullspace or posture bias. Redundant (extra-DOF) arms are free to drift in the nullspace;
125 * only the end-effector pose is regulated.
126 * - Per-DOF effort clamping (direction-preserving vector scaling), enabled by default; the
127 * per-joint effort limits are harvested from the controller's BotPrefab (see Initialize).
128 * - No joint/velocity-limit avoidance, friction/gravity compensation, or inertia decoupling;
129 * those belong to richer controllers (see the internal OSC variants).
130 *
131 * Intended as a clean, open-sourceable baseline that works on any articulated arm without
132 * robot-specific tuning tables. */
133
134// NOLINTNEXTLINE(cppcoreguidelines-virtual-class-destructor)
135class MOCHI_API ControllerBasicOscPd : public ControllerBase {
136 public:
137 /* @brief Registration type name for this controller (see
138 * RoboticsContext::RegisterControllerType).
139 * @return This controller's registration type name. */
140 static constexpr std::string_view TypeName() {
141 return "BASIC_OSC_PD";
142 }
143
144 [[nodiscard]] std::string_view GetTypeName() const override {
145 return TypeName();
146 }
147
148 using Params = ControllerBasicOscPdParams;
149 using Obsv = ControllerBasicOscPdObsv;
150 using Target = ControllerBasicOscPdTarget;
151
152 /* @brief Construct a basic operational-space PD controller for the given articulated robot,
153 * optionally holding a borrowed robot-model description (see GetBotPrefab). After construction,
154 * call Initialize(baseLinkName, eeLinkName, error) to resolve links.
155 * @param prefab Optional borrowed BotPrefab model (may be null; must outlive the controller).
156 * @param robot The articulated robot actor to control.
157 * @param error Error status. */
158 ControllerBasicOscPd(BotPrefab const* prefab, Actor* robot, superdex::Error& error);
159
160 /* @brief Two-phase initialization: resolve base and end-effector links by name.
161 * Must be called after creation and before @ref ComputeOutput.
162 * @param baseLinkName Name of the base link (root of control chain).
163 * @param eeLinkName Name of the end-effector link.
164 * @param error Error status. */
165 void
166 Initialize(std::string_view baseLinkName, std::string_view eeLinkName, superdex::Error& error);
167
168 /* @brief Get controller parameters.
169 * @return The params. */
170 [[nodiscard]] Params const& GetParams() const;
171
172 /* @brief Set controller parameters.
173 * @param params Params.
174 * @param error Error status. */
175 void SetParams(Params const& params, superdex::Error& error);
176
177 /* @brief Configure from a scene-file controller entry: reads "baseLinkName"/"eeLinkName" from the
178 * init args and resolves them, then loads params. Override of ControllerBase. */
179 void ConfigureFromSceneEntry(
180 std::string_view paramArgs,
181 std::string_view initArgs,
182 superdex::Error& error) override;
183 /* @brief Get the controlled DOF indices (between base and end-effector links).
184 * @return The controlled dofs. */
185 Span<int const> GetControlledDofs();
186
187 /* @brief Get the controlled link indices (between base and end-effector links).
188 * @return The controlled links. */
189 Span<int const> GetControlledLinks();
190
191 /* @brief Get the end-effector link index.
192 * @return The eelink index. */
193 [[nodiscard]] int GetEELinkIndex() const;
194
195 /* @brief Read current robot state from the Mochi actor.
196 * @param error Error status.
197 * @return Observation struct populated from the actor's current state. */
198 Obsv GetCurrentObservationsFromMochi(superdex::Error& error);
199
200 /* @brief Compute control efforts from observation state and target setpoint.
201 * @param obsv Current robot state (positions, velocities, transforms).
202 * @param target Target setpoint.
203 * @param error Error status.
204 * @return Efforts for all DOFs [Nm]. Uncontrolled DOFs are set to 0. Empty span on error. */
205 Span<real const> ComputeOutput(Obsv const& obsv, Target const& target, superdex::Error& error);
206
207 /* @brief Reset internal controller state (e.g., between episodes).
208 * This controller is stateless between steps, so this is a no-op. */
209 void Reset() override;
210
211 protected:
212 static void CheckParams(Params const& params, superdex::Error& error);
213
214 /* The controller parameters */
215 Params _params;
216
217 /* Per-controlled-DOF effort limits [Nm], harvested from the BotPrefab in Initialize (empty when
218 * the controller was constructed without a prefab). Consumed by ComputeOutput when
219 * bApplyMaxOSCTorqueNormalization is enabled. Indexed like GetControlledDofs(). */
220 DynamicArray<real> _effortLimits;
221
222 /* The rigid link that serves as the base of the control chain (generally the 0th link in the
223 * articulation), held as a stale-safe handle plus its index in Actor::GetNestedLinkActors order,
224 * kept symmetric with the end-effector link. Currently only the index is consumed (ancestor walk
225 * / DOF mapping); the handle is retained (like _eeLinkHandle) for future base-frame queries. */
226 ActorHandle _baseLinkHandle;
227 int _baseLinkIndex = -1;
228
229 /* The rigid link to be controlled as end-effector, held as a stale-safe handle and resolved on
230 * demand via ComponentBase::GetScene()->GetActor() so it never dangles if the scene is destroyed
231 * before this controller. */
232 ActorHandle _eeLinkHandle;
233 int _eeLinkIndex = -1;
234
235 /* The indices of the dofs between the eeLink and baseLink */
236 DynamicArray<int> _dofIndices;
237 /* The indices of the links between the eeLink and baseLink */
238 DynamicArray<int> _linkIndices;
239
240 /* The Jacobian of the forward kinematics function (controlled DOFs only) */
241 Matrix<real> _jArm;
242 /* The efforts to be applied (all DOFs; uncontrolled DOFs are 0) */
243 ColumnVector<real> _efforts;
244
245 /* The robot DOFs for the controlled links only */
246 ColumnVector<real> _positionsArm;
247 /* The velocity of the controlled links only at the current timestep */
248 ColumnVector<real> _velocitiesArm;
249
250 /* Pre-allocated temporaries for ComputeOutput (sized in Initialize) */
251 Matrix<real> _tmpJArmRoot; /* 6 × numArm */
252 ColumnVector<real> _effortsArm; /* numArm */
253
254 ~ControllerBasicOscPd() override = default;
255};
